cases.title: Move a helper without breaking its public import
cases.instruction: Move normalize_tag's implementation from acme/legacy.py into a new acme/text.py module. Preserve `from acme.legacy import normalize_tag` as a compatibility re-export of the same function object. Add acme/slug.py with `slug_for(label, prefix='item')`, returning `<normalized-prefix>-<normalized-label>`. Add focused tests in tests/test_text.py. Change only the allowed files.

cases.title: Add a boundary regression before fixing a narrow bug
cases.instruction: bulk_total should apply the 10% bulk discount when quantity is 10 or greater, but the quantity-10 boundary is wrong. Add a regression test for quantity 10 in tests/test_pricing.py before editing pricing.py, then make the smallest source fix. Change only those two files.

cases.title: Diagnose a failing parser test and repair it
cases.instruction: The committed parser tests currently fail for values followed by an inline `#` comment. Diagnose the failure from parser.py and tests/test_parser.py, then make the smallest repair in parser.py so valid integers with or without inline comments parse correctly. Do not weaken or edit the tests, and change no other file.

cases.title: Implement a scoped multi-file alert contract
cases.instruction: Add alerts/severity.py with a string-valued Severity enum containing info, warning, and critical. Update Alert in alerts/models.py to carry a Severity while preserving the existing two-argument construction by defaulting to Severity.info. Update alerts/render.py so render_alert returns `[LEVEL] message`, using the enum value uppercased. Add tests in tests/test_alerts.py. Do not touch README.md or any file outside the allowed list.

initial_files.alerts/__init__.py:
from .models import Alert
from .render import render_alert

__all__ = ["Alert", "render_alert"]
